packageRules.description: Group all GitHub Actions updates together, keep SHA pinning per repo policy (zizmor/gitleaks/scorecard workflows rely on this)
Group Python dependency updates from requirements.txt / requirements-dev.txt
Group Docker base image updates for FPolicy server

Hold the FPolicy server on Python 3.12. The repository runs 3.12 everywhere else -- every Lambda Runtime, and the CI test matrix -- so letting this image move alone would run fpolicy_server.py on a Python that nothing tests it against. Patch releases within 3.12 still flow, so this is a version ceiling and not a freeze. 3.12 to 3.14 is a minor bump for Renovate (major is 3), so the major-approval rule below does not catch it; that is why this ceiling is explicit. Raise it together with the Lambda runtimes and the CI matrix, not separately. Declined in #63, where the 3.14 image was verified to build and run before being turned down -- the objection is the divergence, not a defect.
Require manual approval for major version bumps
